r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: BLOCKER: CREW_CONTEXT.md's project-specific simplification-limits gate ('Verification By Region' + 'Review Blockers') is a documented review blocker when skipped or failing on in-scope Python -- and it fails here. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards â€” an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
